name: CS2 Competitive Dashboard Pro
description:
Turn your Stream Deck into a complete CS2 competitive dashboard.

CS2 Competitive Dashboard Pro combines live local Counter-Strike 2 telemetry, session performance, Premier and Competitive views, FACEIT stats, and ready-to-use Stream Deck profiles in one configurable plugin.

Live CS2 tracking is automatic. The plugin detects your Steam/CS2 installation, installs its local Valve Game State Integration config, and receives gameplay updates through an authenticated localhost-only listener. No live-tracking API key is required. If CS2 was already running on first install, relaunch it once so the game loads the new GSI config.

Live Match actions can show score, round state, kills, deaths, assists, K/D, health, armor, money, equipment value, current weapon, ammo, map, team, and supported bomb state. Session actions track matches, wins/losses, K/D, ADR, and headshot percentage across your current play session.

For optional account data, enter your Steam profile and your own provider keys. Premier CS Rating, Competitive map ranks, recent Competitive results, win rate, and Leetify Rating use Data Provided by Leetify where available. FACEIT powers Elo, level, region, K/D, HS%, win rate, recent record, and recent match information. Provider requests go directly from the plugin to the matching provider over HTTPS; customer provider keys and raw GSI data are never sent to a PackRat server.

Includes editable Competitive and Live Match profiles for Stream Deck, Stream Deck Mini, Stream Deck XL, Stream Deck +, and Stream Deck Neo. The profiles install ready to use without automatically taking over your active profile.

Requires Windows and Stream Deck 6.9 or later. Online Leetify/FACEIT features require a matching provider profile and customer-owned provider key; local live and session features do not.

release_notes: Initial release. Automatic local CS2 Game State Integration, configurable live match telemetry, session K/D/ADR/HS% and record tracking, Premier and Competitive views with Data Provided by Leetify through customer-owned access, FACEIT Elo and performance views through customer-owned FACEIT access, ready-to-use Competitive and Live Match profiles for supported Stream Deck models, localhost-only authenticated GSI, direct provider requests, guided setup, private/not-found/rate-limit states, persistent host diagnostics, and recovery tooling.
